name: phone
description: Talk with a bot by voice, in the app or on your phone, and cut in whenever you like. It works in the background while you talk, and in a chat room, calls all its bots. Voice providers are logins: ElevenLabs, Deepgram, one you have, a speech server on your machine, or your browser's own speech.

providers.name: ElevenLabs
steps: Choose Create API key, and give it Text to Speech, Speech to Text, and Voices read access.

providers.name: Deepgram
providers.about: Listening with Flux, and Aura voices
steps: Open API Keys, and choose Create a New API Key.

providers.name: Speech server
providers.about: Speaches, LocalAI, Kokoro-FastAPI, whisper.cpp, or any server with OpenAI's audio endpoints, on this machine
providers.hint: In a container, localhost is fxbot's own: give the machine's address, as for Ollama.

settings.name: to
settings.description: Your phone, the only number bots call, such as +15557654321

settings.name: quiet
settings.description: Hours a bot doesn't call on its own, in your time zone

settings.name: perDay
settings.description: The most calls one bot makes on its own in a day, 1 to 20

settings.name: pause
settings.description: How long you can go quiet on a call before the bot answers, so you can think or stumble mid-sentence, 1 to 5 seconds

settings.name: callThinking
settings.description: How hard a bot thinks on a call, so it answers quickly: its subagents keep their own level

settings.name: googleListening
settings.description: Let Chrome send what you say to Google, when This device listens and Chrome has no language on the device
